sources.title: KAIST DreamX Repurposes Video Diffusion as Latent-Action Learner | AI ...
sources.snippet: KAIST AI's DreamX compresses each latent video frame 300x, from 1,200 tokens down to 4, by reusing a pretrained video diffusion model. On LARY-Bench, the paper claims state-of-the-art performance among latent action models and reports zero-shot action transfer across human and robot embodiments.

sources.title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
sources.snippet: We introduce DreamX, which repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a universal latent action learner. Our approach extracts compact latent actions from the video model's rich spatiotemporal features, compressing each latent video frame by 300× (1,200 → 4 tokens).

sources.title: DreamX Compresses Video Diffusion Models 300x for Robotics
sources.snippet: KAIST AI's DreamX reduces video diffusion tokens from 1,200 to 4, achieving state-of-the-art on LARY-Bench with zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer.
